recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-17841; future serial-number questions should be handled in the FHIR-47622 lineage or a new Pharmacy decision.
issue_request: FHIR-17841 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and requested Medication.identifier 0..* Identifier, removal of Medication.batch.serialNumber, and clarification that serial numbers would be included as an identifier.
initial_application: Historical commit f854395eff4cb4fbc726a46b75955a1359be1c26 applied the tracker in the Medication spreadsheet by adding Medication.identifier 0..* Identifier, deleting Medication.batch.serialNumber, and changing the search parameter from serial-number on Medication.batch.serialNumber to identifier on Medication.identifier.
additional_context: Medication is active and approved in source/fhir.ini. A later applied R6 tracker, FHIR-47622, refined the model so physical-instance identifiers such as serial numbers are represented by Medication.instance.identifier while Medication.identifier remains the medication business identifier; that later issue is already represented on the combined branch by commit 6b4f960128acaeaaa8484b46d7ef6b47ef85440f.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already satisfies FHIR-17841 when interpreted with later FHIR-47622 decisions.
